description: A Commander decklist read whole: its bracket and why, the themes it is built around, and the functional categories (ramp, card draw, removal, …) it is short on.

decklist.description: One card per line (`1 Sol Ring`), at most 250 distinct cards and 20,000 characters. A `Commander` heading or `*CMDR*` marks the commanders.
